title: Learnings Repo Index Row
description: One row per package per index file. Appended; never overwritten.

taskKey.description: Matches manifest.json:taskKey. Keys indexes/by-task/<taskKey>.jsonl - the cross-attempt family. Shape is normative: the normalized-ticket form (lowercase alnum runs joined by single hyphens, exactly what derivation emits) or task-<16hex> for ticketless work. Ticket-correspondence (taskKey equals the normalized manifest.task.ticket when present) is a cross-field rule the reference validator enforces - JSON Schema cannot express it.

packagePath.description: Repo-relative path to the package directory, e.g. packages/2026/07/03/fleet/.../run-slug.

surface.description: Safe-segment shape (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

project.description: Safe-segment shape (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

domain.description: Safe-segment shape or empty (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

engineer.description: Safe-segment shape (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

flow.description: Safe-segment shape (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

packageSchemaVersion.description: The schemaVersion of the package this row indexes. Mining passes MUST record which schemaVersions they consumed.

hasGrade.description: True iff the package includes grade.json. Lets consumers filter graded runs without opening packages.

gradeSemantic.description: Copied from grade.json:recipe_semantic when present. Enables corpus-level filters straight from the index.
